acceptance: Every required semantic check must be established by newly extracted structured facts or marked depth_failed/incomplete. Source snippets, node counts and old frozen capture facts cannot satisfy semantic depth. Unknowns remain incomplete, not correct.

checks.assertion: Registry key is reflect.TypeOf(key[C]{}); AddHandler[C] mutates a package-level map. Dispatch lacks an unconditional concrete handler target without matching C and registry/config context.
Missing map key returns an ordinary error value; found path type-asserts handler.(commandHandler[C]) and returns Handle(ctx,cmd) error. Normal return does not establish nil-error success.
Begin error returns immediately; defer rollback registered after successful Begin; InsertTx(ctx,tx,job,nil) error returns before Commit; success path returns tx.Commit(ctx) result.

InsertTx transaction completion is separate from worker execution/delivery. Source config in this same selected file has MaxAttempts:1 and JobTimeout:5*time.Hour; neither establishes exactly-once delivery.

INSERT policy_rulesets columns pno12,model_year,spec_market,local_edition_code,policy_id,rule_set_path bind respectively Car.Pno12.String(),Car.ModelYear,Car.SpecMarket,Car.LocalEditionCode,PolicyID,RulesetPath as $1..$6.

create/update return nil only when Exec err is nil, but outer Upsert commits after upsert returns nil; Commit error is wrapped and returned. create returning nil proves no transaction commit by itself.

AddressInput onPlaceChanged invokes handlePlaceChanged, guards autocomplete and geometry, calls onSelectAction with address/lat/lng; StepAddress binds onSelectAction={handleSelect} and POSTs only {lat:location.lat,lng:location.lng}. Library callback invocation remains declared rather than observed.

handleSelect awaits fetch then checks !res.ok then awaits res.json; success sets isEligible(data.eligible), catch sets false, finally loading false. Continue button invokes onNextAction and is disabled when loading || isEligible !== true.

Confirmation native button handler calls submitData() WITHOUT await or return and immediately invokes tracker.customEvent; submitData itself sets loading and awaits POST fetch with JSON.stringify({rows,childrenAmount}). Button disabled guard is hasEmptyFields || loading.

submitData awaits res.json only after !res.ok check. incomeSection.status eligible passes six incomeSection.details fields to onNext; else calls onNext() without payload. catch logs and does not onNext; finally loading false.

POST awaits req.json, validates numeric lat/lng, awaits lookup GET with lat -> lat and lng -> lon URL selector; awaits lookupRes.json and derives desoCode/municipalityCode into eligibility POST JSON with constants monthsAtAddress=4 and monthsInArea=12.

Missing API key yields500; invalid lat/lng yields400; failed lookup/eligibility returns respective downstream status; missing desoCode yields400; successful body {eligible} derives geography section status; unexpected catch yields500.
When updatedCustomer.equals(previousCustomer), return updatedCustomer without validate, save or postProcess; these calls occur only after the early-return branch.

On changed-customer path validate(updatedCustomer) precedes updatedCustomer = customerRepository.save(updatedCustomer), and postProcess(previousCustomer, updatedCustomer) receives the REBOUND save result, which is also returned.

postProcess is source-declared @Async void; calls publishCustomerEvent then publishAnalyticsEvent then audit log then marketing consent in that method. Runtime async proxy/activation is unresolved within the fixed file set; do not assert synchronous completion or guaranteed scheduling.
Null kafkaTemplate OR disabled settings returns completedFuture(null) with no send on that branch.

Return value is kafkaTemplate.send(message).thenRun(log callback), a CompletableFuture<Void>; send invocation/returned handle, completion callback and consumer delivery remain distinct. settings.topicName(), updated.customerId(), event, VERSION, PRODUCER_ID construct the published message.
Within try: upsertCustomerArchive(customer) precedes deleteCustomer(customer.customerId()), then addExpired. Catch(Exception) calls addFailed and logs, allowing iteration to continue.
If archive upsert succeeds and later customer delete throws, catch increments failed; fixed scope establishes neither transaction rollback nor compensation across repositories.
